speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this rash, and does the numbness or tingling occur only on the palms or do it extend to your fingers and face as well?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your occupation with livestock and rice farming, have you had any close contact with animals that might have carried mites, or have you noticed the rash worsening during specific seasons? Also, do you have any joint pain or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Human Sarcoptes Scabiei (Scabies) with secondary sensory neuropathy and hypopigmentation. REQUEST IMAGES: Close-up dermoscopy of rash and eyebrows.
